{{Short description|French writer and essayist (born 1959)}}
[[File:Isabelle_Jarry-FIG_1995.jpg|thumb|Isabelle Jarry-FIG 1995]]
'''Isabelle Jarry''' (born 2 October 1959 in [[Paris]]) is a French writer and essayist.

She is a member of the Board of Directors of the {{ill|Maison des écrivains et de la littérature|fr}}.<ref>{{Cite web
| url =http://www.m-e-l.fr/presentation.php
| title =Présentation
| accessdate = 25 December 2016
}}</ref>

She is a chevalier of the [[Ordre des Arts et des Lettres]].
